changeSet.sql: UPDATE match_engine.trade_completion_view SET order_applied_at = GREATEST(buyer_order_applied_at, seller_order_applied_at) WHERE buyer_order_applied_at IS NOT NULL AND seller_order_applied_at IS NOT NULL;

changeSet.comment: Drop unused completion marker secondary index to reduce hot-path marker insert cost

changeSet.comment: Drop unused trade execution order lookup indexes from the write hot path
changeSet.sql: DROP INDEX IF EXISTS match_engine.idx_trade_executions_buyer_order; DROP INDEX IF EXISTS match_engine.idx_trade_executions_seller_order;

changeSet.author: eap
changeSet.comment: Drop redundant trade outbox aggregate uniqueness from the write hot path
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE match_engine.trade_outbox DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS uk_trade_outbox_event_aggregate;

changeSet.author: eap
changeSet.comment: Use trade_id as the trade execution primary key to avoid a redundant surrogate-key index write

changeSet.author: eap
changeSet.comment: Drop unused trade execution uniqueness constraints that are not part of runtime idempotency

changeSet.author: eap
changeSet.comment: Allow TradeExecuted outbox rows to reference durable trade facts instead of duplicating payload
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE match_engine.trade_outbox ALTER COLUMN payload DROP NOT NULL;

changeSet.author: eap
changeSet.comment: Support TradeExecuted outbox relay scans ordered by durable creation sequence

changeSet.author: eap
changeSet.comment: Support checkpoint-based TradeExecuted publication from durable trade facts
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS match_engine.trade_publish_checkpoints ( relay_name VARCHAR(100) PRIMARY KEY, last_created_at TIMESTAMP, last_trade_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_error TEXT, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT ck_trade_publish_checkpoint_attempt_non_negative CHECK (attempt_count >= 0) );
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_trade_executions_created_trade_id ON match_engine.trade_executions(created_at, trade_id);
